title: iProp: Interactive Prompt Optimization for Large Language Models with a Human in the Loop
abstract: Interactive prompt optimization for large language models with a human in the loop. Users interact with the system to iteratively refine prompts through dialogue.

records.subject: iProp
records.claim: iProp is an interactive prompt optimization system for large language models that includes a human in the loop.
